*v1.1 verdict:* PROCEED. Angle a standard explainer lacks: the size trade-off (why ~1.2 mm, not smaller) and where the clue fails. Confidence: مرجح.  
*v1.1 recommendation:* **A** - clearest visual with an honest control; later finalists carry the size and limits stories
